# Airstitch. ## Your chief of staff, in your texts. ## Similar Products. Pally - One text away from done. ### Engineering & Development. ### LLMs. ### Productivity. ### Marketing & Sales. ### Design & Creative. ### Social & Community. ### Finance. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. Congratulations on your launch, interested to see where this product goes! Do you plan on connecting more applications in the future like google keep/tasks? @guy\_morad Thanks so much, Guy! And yes 100% — Google Keep/Tasks are on our list, along with ClickUp, and a few others people keep asking for. Goal is basically: whatever tools you use, you should be able to control them from one WhatsApp thread. Soon will be on iMessage & SMS! Just our luck — we woke up on launch day to a global Supabase outage 😂. Instead of celebrating, we spent the morning firefighting error logs and refreshing status pages. Honestly, it hurt — we had ~80 upvotes early and definitely lost a bunch of signups to broken auth and timeouts. But that’s startup life, right? Things break exactly when you need them most. Huge shoutout to everyone who still showed love despite the chaos. We’re back up now, and we’re doubling down on making the experience even smoother for everyone trying Airstitch today. Your support literally carried us through the outage. If you tried to sign up earlier and it failed, it should work now — we’d love for you to give it another shot 🙏. Turning workflows into something as simple as a text message is such a fresh angle. we are coming up with something really special this week too, stay tuned :)).
